items.label: Max EOD Trailing Drawdown
items.detail: Trails end-of-day balance. Locks at initial balance once 4% profit is reached. Example: $100K start → floor at $96K, rises daily with EOD balance, locks at $100K once EOD exceeds $104K.

items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: 2.5% of previous day's closing balance. Resets at 16:00 CT. If breached, trading disabled until next day and open trades auto-closed. Example: $110K balance → floor at $107,250.

items.label: Profit Target
items.detail: No profit target — funded from day 1.

items.label: Consistency Score
items.detail: Biggest winning day ÷ total profit ≤ 20% at all times and for payout eligibility. Must keep trading until ratio drops to 20% or below.

items.label: Risk Per Trade Idea
items.detail: Max 1% of initial balance per trade idea. Correlated assets = 1 idea. New trade within 10 min of close = same idea. SL required. Effective 7 Apr 2026.

items.label: KYC Deadline
items.detail: KYC documents + contract required within 48 hours of purchase. Mandatory before any payout.

items.label: Inactivity Limit
items.detail: No activity (Sunday–Friday) = account closure. A traded day requires at least one fully completed round-trip trade.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: No restriction on news hours. Not recommended due to slippage and gap risk.

items.label: Overnight Hold
items.detail: All trades must be closed before 3:30 PM CT (Mon–Fri). Risk team starts closing at 3:28 PM CT.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: All trades must be closed before 3:30 PM CT Friday. If open: auto-closed AND account permanently terminated.

items.label: Agricultural Contracts
items.detail: CBOT (Corn/Wheat/Soybeans): 8:30 AM–1:20 PM CT. CME Cattle/Hogs: 8:30 AM–1:05 PM CT. Must close before respective market hours.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Available after first executed trade. Consistency ≤ 20% required.

items.label: Consistency
items.detail: Biggest winning day must not exceed 20% of total profit at time of payout request.

items.label: Max Funded Accounts
items.detail: Whichever is reached first. Once at cap, must wait for an account to close before activating another.

items.label: Live Account
items.detail: Invitation only after 10+ payouts and $50,000+ in total rewards.

items.label: Tradable Instruments
items.detail: Equity Index, Currency, Energy, Agricultural, and Cryptocurrency Futures.
